title.sl: Must, have to, should · Moram, ne smem, ni treba
title.de: Must, have to, should · Müssen, nicht dürfen, nicht müssen
title.it: Must, have to, should · Dovere, non potere, non servire
title.en: Must, have to, should · Need, not allowed, no need

description.sl: have to in must + osnovna oblika, brez to za must. mustn't: ne smeš; don't have to: ni ti treba. Preteklik: had to. Nasvet: should.
description.de: have to und must + Grundform, bei must kein to. mustn't heißt: du darfst nicht; don't have to: du musst nicht. Vergangenheit: had to. Ein Rat: should.
description.it: have to e must + forma base, con must niente to. mustn't: non devi (è vietato); don't have to: non serve. Passato: had to. Un consiglio: should.
description.en: have to and must + the base form, no to after must. mustn't: not allowed; don't have to: no need. The past: had to. Advice: should.

review: en, sl, de, it: machine-written (Claude), not reviewed by a native speaker

instruction.sl: Pick the right words · Izberi prave besede
instruction.de: Pick the right words · Wähle die richtigen Wörter
instruction.it: Pick the right words · Scegli le parole giuste

exercises.prompt: The trip is free. You ___ pay.

explain.sl:
**Ni treba: don't have to. mustn't pomeni ne smeš!**
- **You don't have to pay.** · Ni ti treba plačati.
- **You mustn't pay.** · Ne smeš plačati.
explain.de:
**Nicht nötig: don't have to. mustn't heißt: du darfst nicht!**
- **You don't have to pay.** · Du musst nicht zahlen.
- **You mustn't pay.** · Du darfst nicht zahlen.
explain.it:
**Non serve: don't have to. mustn't vuol dire: è vietato!**
- **You don't have to pay.** · Non devi pagare (non serve).
- **You mustn't pay.** · Non devi pagare (è vietato).
explain.en:
**No need: don't have to. mustn't means it isn't allowed**
- **You don't have to pay.**
- **You mustn't pay.**

instruction.sl: Which are right? · Katere so pravilne?

options: She has to work on Saturday.
She have to work on Saturday.
Do you have to wear a uniform?

explain.sl:
**must + osnovna oblika brez to; she → has to; vprašanje z do**
- **I must go.** · Moram iti.
- **She has to work.** · Mora delati.
explain.de:
**must + Grundform ohne to; she → has to; die Frage mit do**
- **I must go.** · Ich muss gehen.
- **She has to work.** · Sie muss arbeiten.
explain.it:
**must + forma base senza to; she → has to; la domanda con do**
- **I must go.** · Devo andare.
- **She has to work.** · Deve lavorare.
explain.en:
**must + the base form, no to; she → has to; questions with do**
- **I must go.**
- **She has to work.**
